officialSources.observation: Official City Catastro portal identifies AMB Catastro as Cartagena gestor catastral and links to the public Geoportal.
Public Geoportal Cartagena shell; frontend exposes candidate vector layer names and bbox API pattern.

Frontend JavaScript declares terrenos, unidades, construcciones, barrios and vias layer routes, requests api/capas/{name}?bbox=..., and uses terrain feature id for details; no parcel property schema was established.
Public service health response names katastermap-prod.
Malformed-bbox validation response was an empty application/json FeatureCollection with no schema; no feature query was made.
Local fetch access denied; this does not establish origin availability or failure and was not treated as provider downtime.
Official AMB Catastro Cartagena homepage links to the Geoportal and identifies AMB as the gestor catastral contracted by the district for conservation and diffusion of the cadastral service.
Official City notice (2025-07-14) describes the public Geoportal as an interactive map to visualize, consult and analyze cadastral/geospatial information.

Official Planning Department page describes MIDAS as free-access and says updated cadastral information generated by AMB is visualized there, with user-facing data downloads. MIDAS is a separate system; no feature schema or downloadable parcel data was requested during this review.

observedClientRoutes: GET /geoportal-cartagena/api/capas/{layer}?bbox={west,south,east,north}; frontend provides EPSG:4326 extent to six decimals, with no field selection.
Frontend selection reads feature property `id`; this is not documented as the native cadastral identifier. Detail/search routes that can return parcel references and addresses were not queried.
viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: Official public Geoportal landing page and app bundle inspected. The frontend builds `GET api/capas/{name}?bbox={bounds}` with extent transformed to EPSG:4326 and six decimal places; it requests no `fields`/`outFields` allowlist. The map reads `feature.properties.id` for selection, but neither native cadastral identity nor a property-minimal response is documented. The client also exposes property lookup/detail routes showing cadastral reference, parcel number and address, which were not queried. No official OpenAPI/schema or safe geometry-only attribute contract was located; no feature request or geometry retained.

technicalBlocker: The official public Geoportal frontend requests `api/capas/{layer}?bbox={extent}` with a bounded EPSG:4326 bbox at 6 decimal places and parses GeoJSON, but it sends no field-selection parameter. It reads a feature property named `id` for map selection; no published schema or contract establishes that this is a native cadastral ID or limits returned properties to geometry plus safe identifiers. The other visible detail/search routes can return property references and addresses, so they were not queried. No feature query or parcel geometry was retained.
remainingUncertainty: The public Geoportal may expose full parcel vectors through its terrenos layer, but no official OpenAPI/property schema or safe geometry-only allowlist was found. The frontend field id is a selection key only; its native cadastral meaning is unverified. A schema-safe feature query cannot proceed until the service contract explicitly limits attributes.
